items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Gene Tunney used to come there all the time and his brother

ctx.x: And it's too bad the band never recorded.

And we didn't have to rehearse a tune. We'd say, 'Well, let's play this tune.' Everybody knew it. I tell my boys -- my students -- you never learn a melody unless you learn the harmony at the same time, because if you don't know the harmony, you don't know the music. You don't know it. So, everybody was familiar with the harmony of everything we played. And it was just fantastic how we could play four-part -- not three-part -- four-part harmony.
